description: Act on links: update modified links or all of them, embed or unembed, open the original in its editor, reveal the file in Finder/Explorer or Bridge, select the linked item on its page, go to the source of a shared-content link, and check InCopy content out, in, or cancel the check-out (Links panel menu > Update Link, Update All Links, Embed Link, Unembed Link, Edit Original, Reveal in Finder, Reveal in Bridge, Go To Link, Go to Source, Check Out, Check In, Cancel Check Out; Edit > Edit Original)

action.description: What to do; update_all needs no links and updates every out-of-date link. cancel_check_out discards changes made since the check-out

folder.description: unembed: write the files into this folder and link to them (default: link back to the original files)

links.description: Which links to act on (rows of the Links panel): link ids or names from list_document_links, the page items whose placed content is linked, the links of the selected items, or every link; status narrows the choice. Not used by update_all

itemIds.description: Page item ids: the links of the graphics or text placed in these frames

names.description: Link names as the Links panel shows them (every link with each name)

selection.description: The links of the selected items

status.description: Keep only links with these statuses; given alone it chooses among every link

name: run_document_link_action
title: Run Document Link Action
